title: With only Default the tier fields and tier rows are hidden
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data'.
  • Use a client whose Tiers list shows only Default (no tier has been made in it).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, in that client.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page from Customers.
  2. Click the edit pencil on the customer card.
  3. Click Cancel.
  4. Open Customers.
  5. Click New Customer.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The card's Pricing section shows Labor Rate, Shop Supplies and Tax.
  • It shows no Work Order Tier or Part Sales Tier row.

Step 2:

  • Edit Customer opens with Default Shop Supplies and Notes.
  • No Work Order Tier or Part Sales Tier field shows.

Step 3:

  • Edit Customer closes.

Step 4:

  • The Customers list shows.

Step 5:

  • New Customer opens with its usual fields.
  • It shows no tier fields.
